rule: OJK's Sandi Bank is the primary source (the "ojk" vote). Otherwise bank_code is the code reported by the most publishers (at least 2, no tie), confirmed when no other code is reported by 2 or more publishers. Records linked by inference stay unverified.

excluded.rapyd: https://docs.rapyd.net/en/bank-payout-indonesia.html lists codes that are not the sandi bank: for 10 banks OJK lists, its code differs from OJK's (e.g. BCA 624 instead of 014, MUFG 632 instead of 042). Its votes were removed on 2026-11-21.
